title: Updates to Product API Mandatory Certifications
breadcrumb: Updates to Product API Mandatory Certifications
label: TIKTOK SHOP · CHANGELOG
subtitle: Updated 2024-12-06
html:
What is changing?

TikTok Shop is implementing new Mandatory Certifications for certain categories. Starting from 2025-02-21, Product APIs will be updated to require Mandatory Certifications for the following categories:

  • COA for Collectibles and Certificate for Autograph Collectibles will be required for the Collectibles category
  • Test reports and Tracking info labelling will be required for the Toys & Hobbies category

Which markets are affected?

The updates of the requirements apply to local sellers in the US market

Who is affected?

Developers with applications that use Create Product, Edit Product, and Partial Edit Product

Which version is applicable?

The updates of the requirements apply to all versions of the related APIs

What action is required?

Without mandatory product certifications, sellers will not be able to create and update products within specific categories Use the Get Category Rule to check what product certifications are required for which categories, and pass the product certification files via the Create Product, Edit Product, and Partial Edit Product to help sellers submit product certification.
